brief: A fast, native Windows file explorer replacement for power users: instant listings, folder sizes, git, terminal, previews.
criteria: Distinct from folder icons, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour.

concepts.name: Eight Blocks
concepts.idea: A 3x3 city grid whose centre is the head: eight blocks around one hub.
rationale: Octo (eight) plus polis (city) built into the shape
Reads as a grid of items, which is what a file explorer is
Two colours, holds at 16 px with the small-size cut

recommendation: Eight Blocks, the one direction chosen.
next_steps: Swap in src-tauri icons if approved
Convert wordmark strokes to outlines for print masters
